expected_response: With the frozen assignment and uniform normalized teacher weights, the local reward should decrease as the matched generated atoms (slots 4,15,22) move toward the real current-state teacher coordinates at tau=0.5, and the pulled-back current-coordinate gradient should be dense even though the direct unmatched-point derivative is zero in local mode. The whole-cloud control should show complete support over all active teacher points with the same dose settings. Realized gradient and displacement RMS are recorded; because clipping is applied, fixed numeric weights do not guarantee identical realized dose between local and whole-cloud runs. The same-clock bridge is an approximation, so any observed effect is a controlled flow experiment on the proxy, not evidence of exact density tilting or of affinity improvement.
falsifier: Reject the activation if any of the following holds: (1) the approved slot set {4,15,22} is not exactly equal to the active teacher-point set, or any hypothesis/region/slot binding differs from the frozen Analyst handoff; (2) the teacher is replaced by an endpoint forecast, final pose, averaged teacher, or independently optimized conformation, or the teacher time is not 0.5; (3) analytic and finite-difference derivatives disagree with the assignment frozen, or moving an active matched point away from its assigned teacher point does not lower the reward; (4) local mode shows nonzero direct derivative on unmatched z atoms, or whole-cloud mode fails to cover all active teacher points; (5) the real-generator pullback term is dropped or the identity term is omitted; (6) execution logs do not match the requested window (starts 0.0/0.1/0.3, end 0.5, 50/40/20 active updates on the 100-step grid) or show zero dose; (7) the paired local and whole-cloud controls differ in candidate, ancestor, reward family, or dose settings. Any such mismatch is a failed implementation check, not a different valid experiment. Separately, the occupancy and axis-dispersion claims are falsified if the R00 soft_mass, R00 cov_xz, or R19 soft_mass percentiles are not above the 0.5 null in a held-out final set with the same batch/root structure, or if the same contrasts appear equally in low-ranked finals.
scientific_rationale: Bindings are taken verbatim from the frozen Analyst handoff: H1_R00_occupancy and H2_R00_axis_dispersion share region R00 with exact slots [4,15]; H3_R19_occupancy uses region R19 with exact slot [22]. The union of active teacher points is therefore {4,15,22}, and the compiler derives that union and the target coordinates from these declarative memberships; no compiler ranking or slot substitution is performed. The teacher is the REAL current-state point cloud at the configured teacher clock tau=0.5 (current_world_A, terminal_slot 30, batch 11, step 50, ancestor_slot 37, parent_copy_verified true), not an endpoint forecast, final pose, averaged teacher, or independently optimized conformation. Teacher slot identity is meaningful only along this recorded lineage; no atom correspondence is assumed between teacher and newly generated molecules. The registered M2-inspired robust point-cloud matching loss is used: with normalized uniform teacher weights w_j, q = sum_j w_j ||z_pi(j) - y_tau,j||^2 and R = -delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1), delta=1.0 A. Spatial assignment is made against generated active atoms and frozen within the derivative; the pocket coordinate frame is retained. Local mode uses only the approved slots and has zero direct background point-cloud loss on unmatched z atoms, though model-mediated forces outside the matched atoms may remain because the real generator Jacobian couples coordinates. The whole-cloud control uses all active teacher points for the SAME candidate, ancestor, reward family and dose settings, so scope effects are separated from strength and exposure-duration effects. Because the teacher is observed at an intermediate clock, it is not mislabeled as a final endpoint: the same-clock bridge z_tau|t = ((1-tau)/(1-t))*x_t + ((tau-t)/(1-t))*f_theta(x_t,t) is used, with gradient dR/dx_t = a*dR/dz + b*J_f_theta(x_t,t)^T*dR/dz, differentiating through actual FLOWR coordinates with frozen parameters and detached categorical/self-conditioning context. This bridge is a one-forward linear approximation to the teacher clock, not an exact future rollout or SDE success probability, and the identity term is retained. No affinity-head gradient is fitted and no additional per-step affinity inference is performed. Native atom/bond transitions remain free; no particle resampling or graph-equality acceptance is requested. Point-cloud imitation is a proxy for the reported terminal observable, not the same function as regional mass or covariance; improved matching is not a guaranteed affinity improvement, and the observable is tested separately. Guidance is active only for start <= t and t+dt <= end <= tau with end=0.5; on the 100-step linear grid, starts 0.0/0.1/0.3 give 50/40/20 active updates, and the suffix completes without guidance or SMC.
